name: SocialDesk
summary: AI social media tool for scheduling posts, a unified inbox for comments and DMs, and AI auto-replies across Instagram, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Facebook and Threads, for solo creators, teams and agencies.
best_for: solo creators, small brands and agencies that want scheduling, a shared DMs and comments inbox and AI auto-replies across six platforms for under $100 a month
skip_if: you need Pinterest or other platforms beyond the six listed, want a permanent free plan, or need independently verified security certificates before you connect client accounts
honest_knock: The page shows dollar signs without naming a currency, and we could not read the yearly amounts behind the "2 months free" toggle. The page says SocialDesk adheres to SOC 2 and GDPR standards but shows no certificate, and the statistics on the page are the vendor's own, not our measurement. Pinterest is not supported yet.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · Starter billed monthly, shown with a dollar sign (the page names no ISO currency code): 5 social accounts, 1 workspace, 1 user, 10 AI images a month
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-06 on socialdesk.ai) SocialDesk sells four monthly plans and every one starts with a 7-day free trial that, per the page, needs no credit card. Starter costs $19 a month for 5 social accounts, 1 workspace, 1 user, unlimited scheduled posts, 10 AI images a month, AI auto-replies for comments and DMs, a unified inbox and MCP access. Team costs $39 a month and adds 20 social accounts, unlimited team members and workspaces, 20 AI images, a post approval workflow, API access and priority support. Pro costs $59 a month for 50 accounts and 50 AI images, and Max costs $99 a month for 100 accounts, 100 AI images and VIP priority support. A Yearly toggle on the page says "2 months free", but we did not read the resulting yearly amounts. The page shows dollar signs without naming a currency and does not mention tax. Custom limits, invoicing and onboarding are available through contact@socialdesk.ai.

schema_offer.description: Starter, Starter billed monthly, shown with a dollar sign (the page names no ISO currency code): 5 social accounts, 1 workspace, 1 user, 10 AI images a month; Team $39, Pro $59, Max $99; a Yearly toggle says 2 months free but the yearly amounts were not read (read 6 Nov 2026). Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-06.

compare_with.why: Vista Social is in our dossiers as a social media management platform. SocialDesk is a narrower, cheaper AI-first alternative whose selling points are AI auto-replies and a unified inbox, with four flat plans from $19 a month

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested SocialDesk in an account that we made, on its free trial and without a connected social account: the Agent with a list of generic post ideas, the AI Assist caption in the composer, the plan window on the Monthly and Yearly tabs in dollars, the subscription page and the place of the Delete Account button. Posting, scheduling and the inbox were blocked because no account was connected. Nothing was published and nothing was paid. Start and account: the test started at 16:11 (Dutch time) in an account that we made, already logged in on the vendor app, in our own tab, on a free trial. The app has no language setting and the screens are in English. The dashboard showed 7 days left in your free trial and a checklist Finish setting up, 0 of 3 done: Connect your social accounts, Publish your first post and Schedule a post, the last two with the text Unlocks once an account is connected. No card, phone number or call was asked. Core action BLOCKED: posting, scheduling and the inbox need a connected social account and none was connected, on purpose. The Agent page says Connect an account to put me to work, and that it can already brainstorm ideas and captions, but that to draft posts, plan your week or reply to comments and DMs it needs a connected social account. The Posts page says Connect a social account to publish and schedule from here. The composer says No account to publish to, with Connect Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, X or Threads, then come back to this post, and No account connected yet, save it as a draft. Publishing, scheduling, auto-replies and Plan my week were therefore not possible, and nothing was connected, published or scheduled. What did work without an account: (a) on the Agent page the button 3 post ideas to boost engagement this week gave Here are three engagement-focused ideas for this week, a this or that choice on Wednesday, a behind the scenes moment on Friday and a useful tip on Sunday; the ideas are generic and not shaped to a business. The first try, typing the question in the search field of the dashboard, emptied the field without an answer; the Agent page worked. (b) In the composer (Posts, Create Post) the prompt Announce a spring sale for a small coffee shop and the button AI Assist gave the toast AI generated your caption! and a caption of 195 characters with emoji and four hashtags; AI Assist without a prompt said Please enter a prompt first. The first result (the ideas) came about 1 minute after the start at 16:11 and the caption at 16:13, in 4 steps (Create Post, the text box, the prompt and AI Assist), in about 15 seconds. The draft was not saved (Cancel). Networks: the composer names six networks (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, X and Threads) and no others; YouTube is not named. The Connect account dialog itself was not opened on purpose, so a full list of networks offered there was not seen. Plans: See plans opened the window Choose your plan. Monthly: Starter $19/mo (5 social accounts, 1 workspace, unlimited posts, 10 AI images a month, AI auto-replies, a unified inbox, AI content ideas and a weekly auto-plan, MCP); Team $39/mo, most popular (20 social accounts, unlimited workspaces and team members, 20 AI images a month, a post approval workflow, API access and a priority tier); Pro $59/mo (50 accounts, 50 AI images); Max $99/mo (100 accounts, 100 AI images and a VIP priority tier). Yearly (2 months free): Starter $15.83 /mo (you save $38), Team $32.5 /mo (you save $78, $390 /yr billed yearly), Pro $49.17 /mo (you save $118) and Max $82.5 /mo (you save $198), so the yearly amounts are $190, $390, $590 and $990. Settings, Subscription shows Current Plan Free trial, Trial ends 24 November 2026, Renews on 24 November 2026 and a button Manage Billing; during the trial the limits are at Team level (Social Accounts 20, Workspaces Unlimited, Users Unlimited). Only dollar signs are shown and no currency name. Upgrade and Manage Billing were not clicked, so no payment screen was opened. Cancelling: Settings, Profile has a section Delete Account (Once you delete your account, there is no going back), listing the profile, the spaces and workspaces, the connected social accounts and the posts and drafts; the red button was not clicked. Cancelling a subscription goes through Manage Billing, which was not opened. Not tested: connecting an account, publishing, scheduling, Plan my week, the inbox and AI auto-replies, the post approval workflow, API keys, MCP, the Story tab, AI Image, Hashtags, the Upgrade button and Manage Billing, and YouTube (not offered). Clean up: the account, the workspace and the trial stay as we made them; no account was connected and no draft was saved; one Agent chat 3 post ideas to boost engagement this week remains in the chat list; our tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Almost everything stays locked until a social account is connected, the dashboard search field emptied without an answer the first time, the post ideas are generic, the app has no language setting, only dollar signs are shown without a currency name, and the Connect account dialog was not opened so the full list of networks was not seen.
